title: Smart Wallet Tracker
description: Tracks whale wallets and high-signal KOL buyers across Base, Solana, and Robinhood Chain. Shows who bought, their Twitter identity, buy size, entry market cap, token CA, chain, time ago, bundled-buy flags, CT reaction, and a dump-risk % breakdown. High-conviction signals are surfaced in a dedicated strip. Supports manual wallet tracking with custom lists — tracked wallets are checked first on every background scan, and the feed can be filtered to a list or to tracked wallets only.
